build_GlobalPredicatesSensor: build a Habitat sensor that returns truth values for all PDDL predicates as a binary tensor observation
create_MoveObjectsReward: create a multi-stage rearrangement reward measure that gives distance, pick, and place rewards for moving objects to goals
implement_PddlSuccess: implement a measure that checks if all PDDL goal predicates are satisfied and optionally requires a terminate action
add_PddlStageGoals: add a measure that tracks whether the agent completed each PDDL stage goal at any point during the episode
configure_PddlSubgoalReward: configure a sparse reward measure that grants a fixed reward when each PDDL stage goal is first satisfied
